description: FOMC meeting dates for a year from the Board's official calendar page, flagging meetings with a Summary of Economic Projections (dot plot), notation votes and dates still tentative. For traders, journalists and planners scheduling around Fed days. Covers the years the calendar page lists (recent and next year); older years are on the Board's historical pages. (cost: 1 credit)

year.description: integer, optional, calendar year, default current year
